newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Electrolux 9 month profit lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Electrolux 9 month profit lower.

text.p: Swedish appliance maker Electrolux is expected to post a profit after financial items of 2.46 billion crowns for the first nine months of 1996, a Reuter poll of ten analysts found on Monday.
In the corresponding period a year ago Electrolux reported a profit after financial items of 2.78 billion crowns.
For the first six months of the year, the company posted a 1.81 billion crown profit, implying that the result for the third quarter is expected to be about 650 million crowns.
For calendar year 1996, the average of nine of the ten analysts' forecasts put the profit at 3.62 billion crowns against 4.02 billion in 1995.
Electrolux is due to release its nine month report on October 29.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Enskilda, Fiba, Freningsbanken, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Morgan Grenfell, Penser, Paribas, and Swedbank.
